RESERVE (logged justification, H9e discrimination, last reserve run): RES3 (honest Jacobian, tol 1e-8) left the onset at ~315-320 s, so the lazy Jacobian and the Newton tolerance are not the cause. ANDES zeroes Newton increments below tol_zero = 1e-10 (reset_tiny = 1, default); a 1.3 Hz mode of amplitude ~1e-8 has per-step increments ~0.03 x amplitude, below that threshold. Same configuration as INS (i) with reset_tiny = 0 as the only change. PREDICTION if the dead zone masks the instability: growth of the 1.25-1.3 Hz component starts close to the frozen-time crossing (about 60-80 s, RES3 snapshots) at a rate consistent with the frozen-time real part, i.e. far earlier than 300 s; if the onset stays at ~315 s (+-10 s) the hypothesis is refuted
